meta.name: specialist-review
meta.description: Conducts a focused review from ONE specific specialist's perspective (e.g., Security Specialist, Performance Expert). Use when the user requests "Ask [specialist role] to review [target]", "Get [specialist]'s opinion on [topic]", "Have [role] review [code/component]", or when they want deep expertise in ONE specific domain. Do NOT use for comprehensive multi-perspective reviews (use architecture-review instead) or for listing available specialists (use list-members instead).

copy.tagline: 从特定专家视角审查代码或设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从安全、性能等单一专家角度获得深度审查意见。
